meta.name: exec-briefing-memo
meta.description: Decision needed + recommendation + evidence + tradeoffs, 把复杂材料压成可拍板的一页

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把复杂材料压成可拍板的一页简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速从长篇材料提炼决策要点
copy.tagline_en: Condense complex materials into a one-page decision memo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly distill key decision points from lengthy materials

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会将你提供的复杂材料（如会议记录、调研报告）压缩成一页高管决策备忘录，包含决策问题、推荐方案、关键证据、权衡对比和下一步行动。
howto.when: 当你需要帮助高管快速拍板，提供长会议记录、战略讨论或销售反馈等碎片信息时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一份是否进入 Enterprise Plan 的决策简报。
say.note: 生成包含推荐动作和权衡的一页 memo。

say.text: 根据这些销售反馈和产品数据，做一份高管决策 memo。
say.note: 输入碎片信息后输出结构化简报。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude compresses complex materials (e.g., meeting notes, research reports) into a one-page executive briefing memo with decision needed, recommendation, key facts, tradeoffs, and next actions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to help executives make quick decisions, providing fragmented information like long meeting notes, strategic discussions, or sales feedback.

say_en.text: Write a briefing memo on whether to enter the Enterprise Plan.
say_en.note: Generates a one-page memo with recommendation and tradeoffs.

say_en.text: Create an executive memo from these sales feedback and product data.
say_en.note: Outputs a structured briefing from fragmented input.
